data.name: Varinder
data.gender_notes: Varinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Varinder is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vri' which means man and 'Indra' which is the name of the Hindu God of Rain, Thunder, and Power. The name Varinder is a combination of 'Vri' and 'Indra' and signifies a manly and brave individual. The name Varinder carries the meaning “Brave, Manly” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Hindi. Parents who choose Varinder usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, manly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Varinder is believed to bring spiritual power, courage, and strength to the individual. It is also believed to please the Hindu God Indra, who is the god of rain, thunder, and power.
data.etymology: Varinder belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Manly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Varinder total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
